trust.title: Trust Center - MNSCloud
trust.description: Privacy, security, legal, and data protection information for the MNSCloud public website and platform ecosystem.
trust.heading: Security, privacy, and compliance readiness.
trust.lead: MNSCloud is designed around a public website, public connectors, and a private API control plane. This center explains how privacy, legal notices, security posture, and data protection information are organized.

cards.title: Privacy-first operations
cards.text: Public pages avoid unnecessary data collection. Essential technical logs may still be processed by hosting, security, or delivery systems.

cards.title: Consent-aware website
cards.text: Non-essential analytics, marketing, or functional scripts should only run after explicit consent.

cards.title: Public client boundary
cards.text: Secrets, tenant authority, billing, routing ownership, and policy decisions remain inside the API/control plane.

trust.legalReviewNote: These templates provide a compliance-ready structure. Final legal text must be reviewed and approved by qualified legal counsel before production use.

cookieConsent.title: Privacy preferences
cookieConsent.text: We use necessary technologies to operate this site. Optional analytics, functional, or marketing technologies are used only with your consent.

categories.label: Necessary
categories.description: Required for site security, navigation, admin operation, and consent storage.

categories.label: Analytics
categories.description: Helps understand aggregate traffic and content performance when enabled.

categories.label: Functional
categories.description: Enables optional enhancements such as embedded tools or improved preferences.

categories.label: Marketing
categories.description: Supports campaigns, remarketing, or conversion measurement when enabled.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy - MNSCloud
privacy.description: How MNSCloud handles personal data, privacy rights, international transfers, retention, and contact channels.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains how the MNSCloud public website and related contact flows may process personal data. It is designed to support LGPD, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other privacy expectations, subject to final legal review.

sections.title: Data we may process
sections.body: We may process contact information submitted through forms, technical logs such as IP address and user agent, consent preferences, and communication metadata needed to respond to requests.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
sections.body: Processing may be based on consent, legitimate interests, contractual steps requested by the visitor, legal obligations, or security requirements depending on the context and region.

sections.title: Privacy rights
sections.body: Visitors may request access, correction, deletion, portability, objection, restriction, or consent withdrawal where applicable by contacting the privacy channel listed by MNSCloud.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.body: Some providers or infrastructure may operate outside the visitor's country. Appropriate safeguards should be reviewed before production publication.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Personal data should be retained only for the period necessary for the purpose collected, security obligations, legal requirements, or legitimate business records.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Privacy requests should be directed to the privacy contact configured for the official MNSCloud site or partner deployment.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy - MNSCloud
cookies.description: Cookie categories, consent preferences, and how MNSCloud handles necessary and optional website technologies.
cookies.heading: Cookie Policy
cookies.lead: This policy explains how cookies and similar technologies should be handled by the MNSCloud website.

sections.title: Necessary technologies
sections.body: Necessary storage supports site operation, security, admin workflows, and remembering consent choices. These are not optional because the site cannot operate correctly without them.

sections.title: Analytics technologies
sections.body: Analytics must remain disabled until the visitor consents. Any analytics provider added later must be documented here and gated by consent.

sections.title: Functional technologies
sections.body: Functional technologies may improve optional website behavior but should not be required for basic access to public content.

sections.title: Marketing technologies
sections.body: Marketing or remarketing tags must remain disabled unless the visitor explicitly accepts them.

sections.title: Changing preferences
sections.body: Visitors can reopen cookie preferences from the footer and update consent choices at any time.

terms.title: Terms of Use - MNSCloud
terms.description: Website terms covering acceptable use, intellectual property, disclaimers, and public content boundaries.
terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.lead: These terms provide a baseline for using the public MNSCloud website and published materials, subject to final legal review.

sections.title: Website content
sections.body: The website presents MNSCloud products, architecture, public connectors, documentation, and educational content. It does not grant access to private control-plane authority or customer environments.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Visitors must not attempt unauthorized access, disrupt the website, scrape private systems, misuse forms, or use content in a misleading way.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: MNSCloud brand assets, content, and product names belong to MNSCloud unless otherwise stated. Third-party marks belong to their respective owners.

sections.title: No implied endorsement
sections.body: References to technologies, providers, or open-source projects indicate compatibility, integration, or ecosystem context and do not imply endorsement unless explicitly stated.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: MNSCloud may update public website content, product positioning, and legal notices as the platform evolves.

dataProcessing.title: Data Processing - MNSCloud
dataProcessing.description: Data processing roles, subprocessors, security expectations, and enterprise privacy readiness for MNSCloud customers.
dataProcessing.heading: Data Processing
dataProcessing.lead: This page outlines the intended data processing structure for enterprise customers and partners. Contract-specific terms should be handled through signed agreements.

sections.title: Roles
sections.body: Depending on the service and contract, MNSCloud may act as controller, processor, or service provider. The final role must be defined in the applicable agreement.

sections.title: Processing instructions
sections.body: Customer data should be processed only according to contract, documented instructions, legal obligations, security requirements, or platform operation needs.

sections.title: Security controls
sections.body: The platform is designed around tenant isolation, authenticated APIs, public/private boundary separation, host agents, logs, monitoring, and security automation.

sections.title: Incident handling
sections.body: Security or privacy incidents should be handled through documented response procedures, customer communication, and legal timelines where applicable.

sections.title: Subprocessors
sections.body: Infrastructure, delivery, security, support, and communications providers may support service delivery. They should be listed in the subprocessors notice when used in production.

subprocessors.title: Subprocessors - MNSCloud
subprocessors.description: Categories of third-party providers that may support MNSCloud website or platform delivery.
subprocessors.heading: Subprocessors
subprocessors.lead: This page provides a public structure for listing providers that may support website, platform, security, communications, or infrastructure operations.

sections.title: Current status
sections.body: Production subprocessors must be confirmed and reviewed before publication. This template is intentionally conservative until official provider lists are approved.

sections.title: Provider categories
sections.body: Potential categories include hosting, CDN, email delivery, security intelligence, observability, payment processing, customer support, and cloud infrastructure.

sections.title: Change notice
sections.body: Material changes to subprocessors should be communicated through this page or customer channels according to contract terms.
